 South Korean shares fall over 1% as hawkish Fed remarks weigh on sentiment
 SECTIONS South Korean shares fall over 1% as hawkish Fed remarks weigh on sentiment By Anupam Nagar , ETMarkets.com Last Updated: Nov 19, 2026, 09:53:00 AM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis South Korean shares fell 1.10% to 5,011.59 on Thursday as hawkish US Federal Reserve signals raised concerns about prolonged high interest rates. Uncertainty surrounding Anthropic’s record-breaking $81.31 billion IPO further weakened sentiment. Major technology, automobile and battery stocks declined, while foreign investors sold shares worth 162.6 billion won.
 ETMarkets.com Market sentiment was also affected by developments in the technology sector. 
 South Korean shares declined more than 1% on Thursday as hawkish remarks from US Federal Reserve officials heightened concerns that interest rates could remain elevated for longer. Caution surrounding artificial intelligence company Anthropic's blockbuster initial public offering (IPO) added to market pressure, according to a report by Reuters.
 The benchmark Kospi fell 55.85 points, or 1.10%, to 5,011.59 as of 0156 GMT.

According to Reuters, investor sentiment weakened after minutes of the Federal Reserve's October 27-28 meeting, released on Wednesday, indicated that policymakers saw increasing risks to the inflation outlook and discussed the possibility of stepping up efforts to contain price pressures, despite agreeing to keep interest rates unchanged for the time being.
Adding to concerns, Fed Governor Christopher Waller called for a more aggressive response to inflation, suggesting that the central bank could consider a half-percentage-point rate hike at its December meeting or signal a faster pace of increases in 2027.
 Live Events
Market sentiment was also affected by developments in the technology sector. Anthropic raised $81.31 billion in its IPO on Wednesday, surpassing SpaceX's offering to become the largest market debut on record, Reuters reported.
 Also Read | Anthropic's $81 billion IPO overtakes Elon Musk's SpaceX to become the world's largest issue 
 Among heavyweight stocks, Samsung Electronics declined 1.64%, while SK Hynix fell 0.52%. Battery maker LG Energy Solution dropped 2.62%, while Hyundai Motor and Kia Corp lost 2.43% and 1.84%, respectively.
Other major decliners included steelmaker POSCO Holdings, which shed 1.53%, and Samsung BioLogics, which fell 1.76%.
Of the 904 stocks traded on the South Korean exchange, 536 declined and 336 advanced. Foreign investors were net sellers, offloading shares worth 162.6 billion won ($122.02 million).
In currency markets, the South Korean won was quoted at 1,330.7 per dollar on the onshore settlement platform, strengthening 0.23% from its previous close of 1,333.7.
Meanwhile, bond yields moved lower. The benchmark three-year Korean Treasury bond yield declined 1.4 basis points to 3.732%, while the 10-year yield fell 1 basis point to 3.953%.
